TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will staff this 5 MW (aggregate) multi-site program with a dedicated solar delivery team backed by in-country engineering, commissioning, and O&M support. We are an SECP-incorporated private limited company (est. 2012) with ISO 9001 certification and FBR NTN with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, aligned to the RFP’s mandatory eligibility requirements. [CO-PROFILE]

Team capability and governance will be led by a PMP-certified Project Manager from our pool of PMP-certified project managers (6 total), supported by PE-registered engineers (4 total) for design review, method statements, and supervision of electrical works. [CO-PROFILE] Our offices in Lahore, Islamabad (HQ) and Karachi enable rapid mobilization and stakeholder coordination across Punjab, including DISCO interface activities required for net-metering. [CO-PROFILE]

We evidence delivery of multiple solar energy deployments, including provincial and federal government engagements, supporting the RFP’s requirement for prior relevant experience. [CAP-008] [CAP-020] In addition, our track record delivering at operational public-sector healthcare environments informs our approach to hospital access control, shutdown planning, and stakeholder communications during installation and commissioning. [CAP-042] [CAP-018]

Certifications and quality assurance: we operate under ISO 9001 for quality management and maintain ISO 27001 and CMMI Level 3 capabilities to strengthen document control, configuration management, and disciplined delivery across twelve sites. [CO-PROFILE] [CAP-008] [CAP-044]

Our HSE and service quality controls include a documented HSE policy, site safety plans on infrastructure deployments, and a stated record of zero reportable fatalities. [CO-PROFILE] We also maintain an in-country support desk with 24–48 hour response SLAs and offer quarterly preventive maintenance on O&M contracts, aligning to the RFP’s three-year O&M and responsiveness expectations. [CO-PROFILE]

Our library does not yet evidence ISO 14001/OHSAS 18001 or PEC constructor registration (C-A/C-1); we will address any mandatory licensing/third-party requirements through compliant subcontracting and documented supervision under our QA/QC plan. [CO-PROFILE]
